title: The Colleague Who Never Gossiped
paragraphs: Di kantor di mana bergosip tentang rekan kerja lazim terjadi saat jam makan siang, seorang rekan kerja, Maryam, secara konsisten mengalihkan percakapan setiap kali orang mulai mengkritik seseorang yang tidak hadir untuk membela diri.

Pada awalnya, beberapa rekan kerja merasa ini sedikit menjengkelkan, merasa Maryam terlalu ketat tentang percakapan yang tampak tidak berbahaya yang dinikmati semua orang lain tanpa konsekuensi nyata.

Seiring waktu, bagaimanapun, beberapa orang mulai mempercayakan cerita mereka khusus kepada Maryam karena mereka percaya ia tidak akan pernah mengulangi apa yang dibagikan atau berbicara negatif tentang mereka setelah meninggalkan ruangan.

Bertahun-tahun kemudian, ketika Maryam dipromosikan ke posisi kepemimpinan, banyak rekan kerja secara pribadi mengakui bahwa penolakan konsistennya untuk ikut bergosip adalah tepatnya yang mendatangkan kepercayaan tulus mereka.
answerKey: In an office where gossip about coworkers was common during lunch breaks, one colleague, Maryam, consistently steered conversations away whenever people started criticizing someone who was not present to defend themselves. At first, some colleagues found this mildly annoying, feeling that Maryam was being unnecessarily strict about harmless conversation that everyone else seemed to enjoy without any real consequence. Over time, however, several people began confiding in Maryam specifically because they trusted she would never repeat what was shared or speak negatively about them once they left the room. Years later, when Maryam was promoted to a leadership position, many colleagues privately admitted that her consistent refusal to participate in gossip was exactly what had earned their genuine trust.
